summary: H12 is rejected and is not a Golden reference. It reduces many of H11's triangular terrain glyphs, but replaces them with conspicuous round, oval, diamond, and cookie-like canopy units rather than irregular connected forest material. It also fails the unchanged H4 RGB palette-intersection gate (0.707662 < 0.72) and the 25% macrocell-coverage gate (0.815104 < 0.85). Two Vision immediate failures are present, and the score is 66/100, below 94.
required_changes: Replace every closed cookie, coin, oval, and lozenge canopy unit with connected branching foliage, broken edges, variable clearings, and non-repeating stipple or hatching.
Restore RGB palette intersection to at least 0.72 while retaining all other passing palette limits.
Restore 25% macrocell contrast coverage to at least 0.85 without reintroducing repeated triangular or conical symbols.
